title: The Importance of the Good Example in Tarbiyah
reference_info: المنهاج التربوي النبوي — د. عدنان الخليفي

text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of the good example in tarbiyah (upbringing), as the educator who sets an example influences the behavior and akhlaq (character) of learners. The example makes educational concepts transition quickly from words to actions. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is the supreme model in tarbiyah through example.
